# Bessel H

![Bessel H function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/bessel/03_Bessel%20H.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Cylindrical Hankel function. type=0 selects the first kind J+iY; type=1 selects the second kind J-iY. One complex F64 output preserves both components. Requires r&gt;0 and type in {0,1}; r=0 is singular. This evaluates a function, not a Hankel transform. Formula: J_v(r)+i*Y_v(r) for type=0; J_v(r)-i*Y_v(r) for type=1. Example: H_0^(1)(1)=0.7651976865579666+0.08825696421567696i.

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

Cylindrical Hankel function. type=0 selects the first kind J+iY; type=1 selects the second kind J-iY. One complex F64 output preserves both components. Requires r&gt;0 and type in {0,1}; r=0 is singular. This evaluates a function, not a Hankel transform. Formula: J_v(r)+i*Y_v(r) for type=0; J_v(r)-i*Y_v(r) for type=1. NI-documented scalar baseline: f64 argument and real order, exact i32 integer order/kind, f64 or complex&lt;f64&gt; outputs. FROG extension: x may be a real numeric Array/Cluster tree; preserve ranks, dimensions, typed empties and ordered fields, using the same scalar order/kind on every leaf. Real f32/f64/integer x leaves and scalar v promote to f64; results always have f64 or complex&lt;f64&gt; leaves. n/type remain exact i32. No additional broadcasting, complex arguments, degree conversion or fractional integer-order rounding. frog_bessel_v1: nonfinite real input or singularity gives NaN (NaN,NaN for complex); invalid type gives INVALID_KIND; finite-result overflow gives signed Infinity; nonzero underflow may round to zero with warning; preserve representable subnormals. Numeric diagnostics use the existing engine channel, with no extra error ports. These categories are FROG, not NI numeric codes. NI classic LabVIEW documents connector types and negative x as abs(x); no runtime NI observation or NXG signature is claimed. FROG owns defaults, required x and numeric diagnostics. FROG defaults: x required, unwired v/n/type=0. Adapter input policy ni_documented_abs_v1, numerical profile frog_bessel_v1. Local Highlight provider: frog.studio.bessel.hankel_cyl.

x: f64; v: f64; type: i32 → Hv(x) [value]: complex&lt;f64&gt;. FROG profiles frog_bessel_v1 / ni_documented_abs_v1 evaluate r=\|x\|; this documentary NI adapter policy is not a mathematical evenness identity or measured NI parity. x is required; unwired order and type default to 0 (FROG choices). No degrees/radians conversion. Scalar NI baseline; FROG also applies scalar order/kind to real numeric x arrays/clusters, preserving dimensions, typed empties and fields. Real leaves promote to f64; result leaves are f64 or complex&lt;f64&gt;. Integer ports remain exact i32; no new broadcasting or complex arguments. Nonfinite input and singularities return NaN; overflow gives signed Infinity, underflow warns and subnormals are preserved. No error terminals. FROG diagnostic categories: SINGULAR, NONFINITE_INPUT, INVALID_KIND, OVERFLOW, UNDERFLOW, NUMERICAL_FAILURE; these are not NI codes.
